y-m-82-07.topic: Kasancewar Derivative da Iyakokin Hagu da Dama
y-m-82-07.goal: Maimakon ra'ayi na farko game da daidaito ko siffa, yanke hukunci ko derivative yana nan ta yadda matsakaitan ƙimar canjin hagu da dama suke tafiya, sannan yi amfani da wannan hukunci ga functions da dama.
y-m-82-07.material: Function f(x)=|x| ita ce x idan x ya kai 0 ko fiye, kuma −x idan x ya yi ƙasa da 0 (karanta: f na x shi ne cikakkiyar ƙimar x). Nemo ko akwai derivative a x=0. Matsakaicin ƙimar canji ita ce (f(0+h)−f(0))/h (h ba sifili ba ne), kuma idan ta kusanci ƙima ɗaya yayin da h ke kusantar 0, wannan ƙimar ita ce derivative. Duba dabam gefen da h yake positive (dama) da gefen da h yake negative (hagu).

y-m-82-07.thinking.1: Yanke hukunci kan iyaka ta hanyar raba hagu da dama

y-m-82-07.prereq.2: Ma'anar derivative (idan matsakaicin ƙimar canji ya kusanci ƙima ɗaya yayin h→0, wannan ƙimar ce) da ma'anar iyakar hagu da dama (gabatarwar calculus; ba a buƙatar dabarun derivative)

y-m-82-07.s.s1.hint.1: Kwatanta lambar da kowane gefe yake kusanta da ita, da ko gefen biyun sun yi daidai.

y-m-82-07.s.s1.st.0.ask: Me kake tunanin derivative a x=0 zai zama?

y-m-82-07.s.s1.st.0.r.b: An yanke wannan hukunci ta kallon gefen dama kawai.

y-m-82-07.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Wannan hukunci ya nuna cewa dole ne a duba kusantowa daga hagu da dama dabam-dabam.
y-m-82-07.s.s1.st.0.o.d: −1 ne, domin a hagu da asali y=−x ne.
y-m-82-07.s.s1.st.0.r.d: An yanke wannan hukunci ta kallon gefen hagu kawai.

y-m-82-07.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Yana kusantar 1 a dama da −1 a hagu, don haka ba ya tabbata a matsayin ƙima guda.
y-m-82-07.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Wannan hukunci ya kwatanta ƙimomin hagu da dama dabam-dabam.

y-m-82-07.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Ka yi amfani da lura ta hagu kawai, ka yi watsi da ta dama.

y-m-82-07.s.s1.st.2.o.a: 0 ne. Matsakaicin ƙimar canji yana kusantar 0 daga dama da hagu.
y-m-82-07.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Wannan hukunci ya duba ko matsakaitan ƙimar canjin hagu da dama suna kusantar ƙima ɗaya.

y-m-82-07.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Babu shi. Yana kusantowa da ƙimomi positive daga dama da negative daga hagu.
y-m-82-07.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ka karanta ƙimomin da aka lura da su ba daidai ba. A ɓangarorin biyu yana kusantar 0 daga ƙimomi positive.

y-m-82-07.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Ka ɗauki ƙimar h guda takamaimai a matsayin derivative. Ana buƙatar ƙimar yayin da ake aika h kusa da 0.

y-m-82-10.material: Ka yi tunanin sashen rami mai siffar parabola (raka'ar tsawo: m). Ƙasa ita ce y=0, faɗin ƙasan kuma 12 m ne (daga x=−6 zuwa x=6). y-m-82-13.topic: Zangon amfani da ƙa’idar kiyasi (shekarun ninkuwar kuɗi)
y-m-82-13.goal: Bincika ko hanyar kiyasi da ta yi aiki ga wasu ƙimar ruwa tana aiki ga duk ƙimar riba, ka nemo yanayin da take gaza da kanka, sannan ka bayyana da shaida zangon da za a iya amincewa da ita.
y-m-82-13.material: Akwai hanyar kiyasi da ke cewa idan ka ajiye kuɗi da riba mai taruwa a ƙimar shekara-shekara r% (ana ƙara ribar cikin babban kuɗi kowace shekara), yana ɗaukar kusan 72÷r shekaru kafin babban kuɗin ya ninka. Bayan adadin shekarun 72/r da wannan hanya ta bayar, ana iya lissafa ninkin babban kuɗin da (1+r/100)^(72/r) (ana lissafa adadin shekarun goma da wannan furuci ɗaya). Idan wannan ninki yana kusa da 2, hanyar kiyasin tana aiki da kyau. Jinseo (mutum na ƙirƙira) ta ga cewa ga r=6, 1.06^12≈2.012, kuma ga r=8, 1.08^9≈1.999, sai ta ce, “Yana aiki da kyau ko mene ne ƙimar ribar.” (Wannan yanayi na ƙirƙira ne, ba shi da alaƙa da kayayyakin kuɗi na gaske.)
